parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page when using paging.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page when using paging.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The server name or IP address.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The running status of the machine. Valid values:

- **monitoring**: Warning.
- **blocking**: Blocking.
- **studying**: Learning.
- **study_finish**: Learning completed.

parameters.name: StudyMode
parameters.description:
The whitelist mode. Valid values:

- **hash**: process hash
- **path**: process path

parameters.name: StudyTimeEnd
parameters.description: The end of the model creation time range. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: StudyTimeStart
parameters.description: The start of the model creation time range. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds.
